title: Bentomux plugin manifest
description: The plugin.json every Bentomux plugin must carry. Generated documentation lives in resources/plugin-skill/; the enforcing code is src-tauri/src/plugin/mod.rs and validate.rs. This file is the single declaration those three are checked against.

id.description: publisher.name, exactly two segments of [a-z0-9-]+. The `bentomux` publisher is reserved for bundled plugins.

name.description: Display name shown in Plugin Studio.

version.description: Semver. Also the on-disk version directory name.

apiVersion.description: Hard gate: the host refuses a major it does not implement.

minAppVersion.description: Soft gate: a mismatch warns, it does not refuse.

description.description: One line shown in the install review.

entry.description: Path to the ES module entry, relative to the plugin root and inside it.

icon.description: A builtin icon name or an image file inside the plugin folder. Inline markup is never accepted.

permissions.description: Namespaces of the app the plugin may use. A contract, not a sandbox.

network.description: HTTPS origins the plugin may fetch() or load images from. Baked into connect-src/img-src at build time; shown in the install review.

contributes.description: What the plugin adds. Declaring an id that is never registered is a warning; registering an undeclared id is an error.

id.description: Must start with the plugin id, e.g. acme.my-plugin.open. Unique across every kind.

title.description: Label shown to the user. Falls back to the id's last segment.

command.description: topbar / sidebar / dock only: the command id this entry fires. Must appear in contributes.commands.
